title: Levels theme
description: A calm health-app light theme: white bands alternating with warm and cool off-whites, near-black ink for text, buttons and the dark bands, warm grey secondary text, and one deep green for links, dots and icons with pale sage and green-grey panels. Hanken Grotesk at medium weight with tight tracking, 10px corners, hairlines and very soft long shadows. A near-black dark sibling.
notes: light is the faithful mode; dark is a sibling in the same spirit
--highlight is the deep green of links and icons, --glow the pale sage of numbers and eyebrows on dark, --accent the pale green-grey panels
--section-y is the desktop padding (8rem); blocks use 0.75 of it on phones
the site's dark bands are .dark scopes, so the dark palette doubles as the on-dark palette of light mode
name: levels-theme
